demos.bond.u.init: More initiative (asks for food, warns, brings gifts)
demos.bond.title: Bond and the door
demos.bond.blurb: Bond grows from time spent together, but each day only counts so much (no grinding). Long absences wear it down slowly, never below a floor. Try leaving the house to see how neediness changes the waiting.
demos.bond.sceneAria: Room with a door on the right. The dog is {w}.
demos.bond.meter: Bond (ticks: unlocks; short tick: decay floor)
demos.bond.cl.high: high: lies at the door, big greeting
demos.bond.foot: Demo values: gains, daily caps, unlock thresholds, the decay rate and the floor are stand-ins; the real ones will be tuned by playtesting. Ignoring never lowers bond here; only long absence does.
demos.bond.busyAway: You are away. Come back first.
demos.bond.capUse: {a}: Rex has had enough of this today. No bond gained (daily cap).
demos.bond.capDay: That is all the bond today can give. Come back tomorrow (daily cap).
demos.bond.ignored: You ignore Rex. No bond gained, and none lost.
demos.bond.decayed: {n} day(s) passed. After {a} days apart, bond fell by {d} (never below the floor of {f}%).
demos.bond.grace: {n} day(s) passed without visiting ({a} apart). Bond only starts to fade after {g} days.
demos.bond.newDay: A new day: the daily cap is reset.
demos.bond.alreadyAway: You are already away. Use Come back.
demos.bond.leaveLow: You leave. Rex is not clingy: he curls up for a nap.
demos.bond.leaveMove: You leave. Rex trots to the door.
demos.bond.backLow: You return. Rex glances up, then goes back to his nap. Calm.
demos.bond.ev.greeted: Rex greets you at the door.
demos.bond.backGreet: You return. Rex greets you at the door.
demos.bond.backGain: Returning home counts as time together: bond +{g}.
demos.bond.start: Spend time with Rex. Each activity counts only a few times per day.
demos.coats.title: Coat lab: genes + seed
demos.coats.blurb: Pick two parents and breed a litter. A coat is stored as genes plus a seed, never as a picture, so the same genes and seed always redraw the same dog. In the real mod genes stay hidden (no scanner); the reveal toggle here is only for this demo.
demos.coats.hint: Same parents and same litter seed always give the same litter. Change the seed to replay a different one.
demos.coats.foot: Demo values: dominance order (black > gray > golden > brown > white), litter size odds, and the patterns' on/off model are simplified stand-ins, not final design.
demos.coats.identical: Identical: all {n} puppies were redrawn from their genes + seed and match pixel for pixel.
demos.coats.statsResult: 200 test litters: your parents average {cur} distinct looks per litter (average size {size}); the pure golden line averages {pure}.
demos.coats.statsShort: Test litters done: {cur} distinct looks on average.

demos.life.title: Life stages and energy
demos.life.blurb: Drag the age and see how the design changes a dog over its life. Below, try the energy toy: energy can overflow past 100%, which triggers a frenzy, and overspending ends in a harmless collapse into sleep.
demos.life.readout: Age {y} mod years = {d} world days. Stage: {s} ({from} to {to} years, days {df} to {dt}).
demos.life.timelineAria: Life timeline for a {y}-year lifespan ({d} world days)
demos.life.energy: Energy (% of capacity; the line marks 100%)
demos.life.isAsleep: Rex is fast asleep. Wait for him to wake.
demos.life.inFrenzy: Rex is in a frenzy; he cannot be given anything to do until it ends.
demos.life.did.sleep: A nap restores a lot of energy.

demos.life.did.force: Frenzy forced for its minimum duration.

age_days = max(previous, today - birth)

          = max({p}, {r}) = {res} days

demos.life.ruleNote: Demo birth day: 100. 1 mod year = 10 world days. There is no clock of its own; age follows the world's day counter, and never goes backwards.
demos.life.foot: Demo values: stage limits follow the current proposals (1 year, 2 years, last 25% of life); energy numbers, capacities and frenzy timing are stand-ins to be tuned by playtesting.

demos.training.title: Cue training simulator
demos.training.blurb: Teach Rex a cue the way the design describes: his name first (attention), then a cue word, a lure, and a treat. Any word works, but it must be the same word each time.
demos.training.sceneAria: Scene: the player on the left, the dog Rex on the right.
demos.training.logTitle: Event log (names from the behavior specs)
demos.training.foot: Demo values: reps needed (3 to 6 by intelligence), attention window, treats until full, and the tiredness limits are stand-ins; the real numbers will live in config and be tuned by playtesting.
demos.training.start: Start by saying the name cue, then give a treat. Three times and Rex learns his name.
